note: THE LARGEST SUBSTANTIVE RECOVERY IN THIS AUDIT SO FAR. The fact carried three names and a date range; the board carries a COMPLETE 29-PERSON HONOUR ROLL, 1980 to 2009, each knighted camper titled Sir or Lady with their year. CORRECTION: the fact reads 'Lady Lindsay Hertland'; the plaque reads KERTLAND -- and a Lindsay Kertland is a CIT in 1985 (f_1611), so the misreading was hiding a person this KB already knows. ARTICLE GAP: the Order of Owens has its own wiki article built from an operator-supplied roster; the Knights of Kanawana is the same kind of institution -- a named honour with a citation, a crest, the camp motto, and a 29-year roll -- and appears nowhere except passing mentions in traditions-and-culture.md and order-of-owens.md. It has a better primary source than Owens did: a photograph of the roll itself. NINE OF THE 29 ARE ALREADY KB PEOPLE: Denys Lawrence (Staff '79), Dave Paltiel (CIT 1975), Lindsay Kertland (CIT 1985), Susan Gamberg and Ryan Harbinson (CITs 1993), Andrew Henle (CIT 1993), Alexander Aylett (CIT 1995), Josh Usheroff (Staff 02), Ali Olshefsky and Ian Braide (Rangers 2002).
